about: The first post to the members' group. One capability: every board has its own page, shown through the Select Board's.

image.headline: Every town board has its own page
image.sub: Here’s the Select Board’s, one of {boards|len} board and committee pages.

text: Welcome to the Lunenburg Budget Project 👋
This is our first post, so let's start with the thing I use most: the board pages.
Every town board and committee has its own page. Open one and you get:
📅 The next meeting: when it is, and what's on the agenda
🗳️ What the board recently voted on
📄 Past meetings, with the agenda, minutes and recording wherever they were posted
🔔 For many boards, a feed you can follow, so you hear when something new is posted
For example, the Select Board meets {nx.date|day}. On the agenda: {nx.hook}.
Try it: pick a board you care about, open its page, and tell us in the comments what you found, or what you wish was there.
